description: Fetches a file from a remote web URL and uploads it into the wiki's File namespace, returning the resulting file title and URL. The upload appears in the wiki's upload log. Works whether or not the wiki has upload-by-URL enabled: the server retrieves the file and uploads it directly, falling back to wiki-side fetching only when it cannot reach the URL itself. Fails if a file with the target title already exists. To replace an existing file with a new revision, use update-file-from-url.

title.description: File title (with or without the "File:" prefix)

url.description: URL of the file to upload

wiki.description: Wiki to target, as a key from the mcp://wikis/ resources (e.g. en.wikipedia.org), or the full mcp://wikis/ URI. Omit to use the default wiki.

name: upload-file-from-url
